races.p: Brown calls Husted the face of data centers in Ohio. Husted led the Senate push for the Ratepayer Protection Act, which failed 57–43. An NRSC memo called data centers the anchor around his neck.
Abbott's audit and permit freeze came amid attacks from Hinojosa, who wants an immediate moratorium and a special session to end tax breaks. She predicts the pause will be lifted after the election.
Both back a pause. Acton wants a conditional legislative moratorium; Ramaswamy promises a first-day executive order halting new approvals until lawmakers pass his Ohioans-First law.

Shapiro went from touting fast permits to his August order requiring local approval before state permits. Garrity wants an open-ended pause so towns can update zoning; at their debate Shapiro said his rules make a moratorium unnecessary.
Two of five seats are on the ballot. Democrats need both to flip the 3–2 Republican majority that sets Georgia Power's rates.
